title: Inverse scalar-comparison coherence predicate
statement:
Let $I$ be a preorder and let $S$ and $P$ be stage systems of categories indexed by $I$, in the stage-system language of [def-weil-pbc-finite-stage-pair-category] used also for the framework system [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Write $S_h:C_E\to C_L$ and $P_h:D_E\to D_L$ for their transitions when $h:E\le L$, and $a^S_{h,k}:S_kS_h\xrightarrow{\sim}S_{hk}$ and $a^P_{h,k}:P_kP_h\xrightarrow{\sim}P_{hk}$ for their associators. Let $F:S\to P$ be a morphism of stage systems: functors $\Phi_E:C_E\to D_E$ and coherent natural isomorphisms $\beta_h:P_h\Phi_E\xrightarrow{\sim}\Phi_LS_h$. Put $j_h=\beta_h^{-1}$; $hk$ denotes the transitive composite of inequalities. Define $\operatorname{FdInverseScalarCoherence}(F)$ to be the conjunction of the following equations, at every object $K\in C_E$, without assuming that $I$ is directed or nonempty. For $h:E\le L$, $k:L\le M$,
$$a^P_{h,k,\Phi_EK}\circ P_k(j_{h,K})\circ j_{k,S_hK}=j_{hk,K}\circ\Phi_M(a^S_{h,k,K}).$$
For $h:E\le L$, $k:L\le M$, $m:M\le N$, define
$$B_K=P_m(P_k(j_{h,K}))\circ P_m(j_{k,S_hK})\circ j_{m,S_kS_hK}.$$
Require both four-field contractions
$$a^P_{hk,m,\Phi_EK}\circ P_m(a^P_{h,k,\Phi_EK})\circ B_K=j_{(hk)m,K}\circ\Phi_N(a^S_{hk,m,K}\circ S_m(a^S_{h,k,K})),$$
$$a^P_{h,km,\Phi_EK}\circ a^P_{k,m,P_h\Phi_EK}\circ B_K=j_{(hk)m,K}\circ\Phi_N(a^S_{hk,m,K}\circ S_m(a^S_{h,k,K})).$$
All equalities use the specified associators, including repeated indices. This is a predicate on the given data; it chooses no comparison.
